newsitem.title: USA: ClinTrials buys Ovation Healthcare Research.
newsitem.headline: ClinTrials buys Ovation Healthcare Research.

text.p: ClinTrials Research Inc said Tuesday it had acquired Ovation Healthcare Research, a privately held economic research and consulting firm to the pharmaceuticals industry, in a pooling of interests transaction.
No purchase price was disclosed, but ClinTrials said in a statement that the acquisition is expected to be mildly accretive to its earnings in 1998.
Ovation will continue to operate from its base in suburban Chicago as ClinTrials Ovation, the statement said, with Jeffrey Trotter remaining its president.
